title: Club Membership: dues price-increase notice and price-lock by tier
content:
## Scope
This document states, for every Club Membership tier, the notice required before an annual dues increase takes effect, and how many months the tier's price is locked against increases from signup.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Notice required before an annual dues increase takes effect | Price locked against increases from signup |
|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 30 calendar days | not locked |
| Student Metro Access | 30 calendar days | not locked |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 30 calendar days | not locked |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 30 calendar days | not locked |
| Premier All-Access | 45 calendar days | not locked |
| Black Card All-Access | 45 calendar days | not locked |
| Founding Legacy Access | 60 calendar days | locked for 60 months from signup |

## Reading the table
A tier marked 'not locked' has 0 months of price protection from signup, meaning an annual dues increase may take effect for that member once the tier's own notice period has run; Founding Legacy Access is the only tier whose price is locked against increases, and only for the stated number of months counted from that member's own signup.
